answer: An agent economy deters Sybil attacks through mutual optical line-of-sight ranging. Nodes authenticate by exchanging narrow-beam laser pulses across complex terrain, verifying physical positions from an exposed knoll to an eroded karst. An adversary incurs inescapable hardware costs deploying distinct steerable transceivers toward each local horizon. However, airborne dust and optical occlusions induce beam attenuation, falsely invalidating legitimate agents.
